item.title: Trump tariffs led U.S. factories to close or cut jobs, and some longtime GOP voters are turning away
item.description: Vandermeer said bringing jobs back had failed, and he plans to vote Democratic in the midterms.

item.title: 10-year bond yields now track diesel prices more closely than crude, and Trump's fuel deal with Putin may be too late
item.description: One analyst said diesel and gasoline, not crude oil, ultimately drive inflation.

item.title: Pope calls death penalty inadmissible after U.S. bishops' head criticizes DOD execution livestream plan
item.description: The Pope said the common good and justice can be upheld without capital punishment.

item.title: MacKenzie Scott gave one-third of America's $19.2 billion in megagifts last year
item.description: MacKenzie Scott donated $7 billion in 2025, bringing her five-year total to $26.2 billion, while keeping a low profile.
